Ben likes basketball very much. After school, we play together. I am happy every day. For example, we caught a small crab at the beach.
Ben and Jack are in the same class. My friend Jack is very kind. Jack likes dumplings too. The kids built the treehouse themselves last summer.
Jack often helps me with music. Ben drinks tea every morning. The holiday plan is not far from my home.
